{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bistro''' was a secondary dining area located on the [[Lido Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. Its food was simpler than that served in the [[Grand Dining Room]], and the atmosphere was more casual.
